name: Alice in Chains

whyMatters.en: Seattle four-piece formed in 1987. Twin-harmony vocals over down-tuned hard-rock riffs; Facelift (1990) and Dirt (1992) sit on the metal side of grunge radio.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图四人组，1987 年成立。双人声和声叠在降调 hard-rock riff 上；《Facelift》（1990）与《Dirt》（1992）站在 grunge 电台偏 metal 的一侧。

lyricQuotes: I'm the man in the box / Buried in my shit
Into the flood again / Same old trip it was back then

shortBio.en: Staley / Cantrell harmony grunge-metal, 1987–. Dirt is the down-tuned radio peak.
shortBio.zh: Staley / Cantrell 和声 grunge-metal，1987 年至今。《Dirt》是降调电台高峰。

body.en:
Alice in Chains formed in Seattle in 1987. Facelift (1990) brought talk-box riffs and close vocal thirds to US rock radio. Dirt (1992) centers Cantrell’s drop-D riffs, Staley’s tenor, and addiction-era lyrics.

Man in the Box (1990) remains a common entry. They share the Seattle map with Soundgarden and Pearl Jam; Cantrell’s riff writing keeps a clearer metal lineage.
body.zh:
Alice in Chains 于 1987 年在西雅图成立。《Facelift》（1990）把 talk-box riff 与贴近三度和声送上美国摇滚电台。《Dirt》（1992）以 Cantrell 的 drop-D riff、Staley 男高音与成瘾题材歌词为中心。

《Man in the Box》（1990）仍是常见入口。与 Soundgarden、Pearl Jam 同属西雅图地图；Cantrell 的 riff 写作更贴近 metal 谱系。

note.en: Odd-meter riff; metal rhythm on grunge playlists.
note.zh: 奇数拍 riff；grunge 播放列表上的 metal 节奏。

title.zh: 偏 metal 的 grunge 上的和声人声

body.en:
Facelift (1990) put Alice in Chains on MTV beside Nirvana and Pearl Jam. Cantrell and Staley’s stacked thirds differ from Cobain’s single-line melody; talk-box and drop-D riffs mark the metal edge.

Dirt (1992) consolidates Rooster, Them Bones, and Would?—slow tempos and odd meters in one album cycle.
body.zh:
《Facelift》（1990）把 Alice in Chains 送上 MTV，与 Nirvana、Pearl Jam 并列。Cantrell 与 Staley 的叠三度不同于 Cobain 的单线旋律；talk-box 与 drop-D riff 标出 metal 边缘。

《Dirt》（1992）收拢《Rooster》《Them Bones》《Would?》——慢速与奇数拍同处一专辑周期。

title.zh: Staley 时期与 DuVall 回归

body.en:
Peak four: Staley, Cantrell, Kinney, and Starr on Facelift; Mike Inez replaces Starr for Dirt and Jar of Flies. Staley’s last recordings taper in the mid-1990s; William DuVall joins for 2006 reunion shows.

Catalog citation still centers Staley/Cantrell harmony on Dirt. The DuVall chapter extends touring more than first-citation radio memory.
body.zh:
巅峰四人：Staley、Cantrell、Kinney、Starr 录《Facelift》；Mike Inez 替 Starr 录《Dirt》与《Jar of Flies》。Staley 最后录音收束于 1990 年代中期；William DuVall 在 2006 重聚演出加入。

目录引用仍集中在《Dirt》上的 Staley/Cantrell 和声。DuVall 章节更多延长巡演，而非首引层电台记忆。

body.en:
Cantrell’s riff writing draws on Black Sabbath and Led Zeppelin; Van Halen-style harmonics appear in Facelift leads. Tool and Deftones later take down-tuned weight and patient dynamics.

What travels most clearly is harmony stacked over sludge-tempo riffs.
body.zh:
Cantrell 的 riff 写作吸收 Black Sabbath 与 Led Zeppelin；Facelift 主音中可见 Van Halen 式泛音。Tool 与 Deftones 后来接过降调重量与较慢动态。

传得最清楚的是和声叠在淤泥速度 riff 上。

interviewQuotes.text: I was using drugs to hide from life, and music was my way out.
